GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward pressed on to find front going 2 Lengths Clear . challenged Soon After Straightening Up , overhauled near 100m # on pace/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned in relation to her tactics adopted in today’s event,  in particular her decision to take up a position in the lead, RE her instructions were to settle outside the leader. After jumping away only fairly, she encouraged EXONUMIA to improve and after doing so the gelding responded well and had strong early speed. She added that after jumping from the widest barrier, the strong early speed and the  formation of the field she felt she would get caught WWC and as a result she thought  it would be in her best interest to roll forward and settle in the lead.

Stwds qtsd rider re tactics she adopted in today’s event, in particular her restraining the gelding near the 800m to the rear of the field. RE her instructions were to lead; however, after beginning only fairly the gelding did not travel as expected and she therefore elected to restrain EXONUMIA to obtain a position with  cover. She added that in hindsight after gaining cover she felt that she may have been better suited in permitting the gelding to travel forward of its own accord rather than restraining. Trainer, Mr G. Lynch confirmed the instructions were to lead. Stwds noted her exp.
